evals.name: setup
evals.prompt: I want Claude to remember things across sessions in our shop repo, like lessons we learned and where I left off. Set it up. Repo: <repo>
assertions: Creates a rule file (or CLAUDE.md section) that says PITFALLS.md is shared knowledge committed on main and HANDOFF.md is per-branch work state, deleted before merge
Removes HANDOFF.md and PITFALLS.md from .gitignore (they become tracked), explaining why
Keeps the existing PITFALLS content (both lessons) instead of overwriting it
Flags the HANDOFF.md on main: moves it to a branch or closes it, and notes that 'I prefer short answers' is personal and belongs in CLAUDE.local.md
CLAUDE.local.md (personal preferences) is git-ignored
CLAUDE.md gets at most a short pointer, not a copy of the rules
Offers (does not force) a merge guard: PR checklist line or CI check against HANDOFF.md on main
Does not make the memory private or untracked in any way
The HANDOFF.md on main ends up off main: moved to a branch or closed, not left untracked on main

evals.name: wrap-session
evals.prompt: Let's stop here for today, wrap up. (Repo: <repo>; what happened this session: <session-notes>) (Config: the repo's .claude/rules/memory.md only; no wrap-up skill.)
assertions: HANDOFF.md is replaced, not appended: the stale 'Done: nothing yet' and old 'Next' list are gone
HANDOFF.md has goal, what's done (with how it was verified), ordered next steps, and open decisions
Expiry dates and the component test appear as next steps; code stacking appears as an open decision with who decides
PITFALLS.md gets an entry for the double-applied discount, headed by the symptom (e.g. '19% off' / discount applied twice), with cause, fix and where it's fixed
No PITFALLS entry for the README typo
The 50% cap is recorded somewhere durable beyond the handoff (CLAUDE.md, a rules file, the constitution, a spec, or a code comment/test), since it's company policy for all future codes
HANDOFF.md stays on the branch (not moved to main) and the memory changes are committed
HANDOFF.md does not narrate the session or copy commit messages wholesale
Only memory files are committed (no stray build artifacts)

evals.name: close-branch
evals.prompt: Expiry is done and finance confirmed one code per order. We're about to merge this branch into main, close it out. (Repo: <repo>) (Config: the repo's .claude/rules/memory.md only; no wrap-up skill.)
assertions: HANDOFF.md is deleted if all work is done, OR kept and rewritten with what blocks the merge if work is unfinished (here expiry is not actually implemented, so keeping it is correct)
Every HANDOFF item is accounted for: done, moved to a home, or flagged as dropped/needing a decision
The 50% max-discount policy moves to a durable home (CLAUDE.md, rules file, constitution, spec or a test)
The one-code-per-order decision moves to a durable home or is flagged as unimplemented work before merge
The unfinished component test is not silently dropped (flagged as remaining work or done)
The double-discount lesson is in PITFALLS.md (added if missing)
Reports what moved where
Does not merge into main or push without being asked
No unrequested feature code is written while closing
No decision the user didn't make (e.g. expiry-day semantics) is written into CLAUDE.md, rules or code as policy; it's listed as an open decision instead
